summary: The current v36 evaluation still stops at step 19 because Val-strt.lua has no loader; 41 of 60 screens remain. C176 has accepted numeric selection storage and OR/sub operations, and C181 has accepted m_initweap plus the shared quest loader registry changes. Those prior ownership blockers are now clear; the remaining source scope is the whole Val-strt.lua loader and nhlsel.c:l_selection_setpoint with its coder-frame binding.

source.branch: Loading the whole Valkyrie quest-start program at makelevel() for the Val-strt special level; its initial random selection points are generated in the level coder frame before the overlay map is placed.
callers: C: do.c:goto_level -> mklev.c:makelevel -> mkmaze.c:makemaz -> sp_lev.c:load_special -> dat/Val-strt.lua.
JS: mklev.js:ensureSpecialLevelLoaders/load_special -> QUEST_LEVEL_LOADERS["Val-strt"] in js/quest_levels.js; C181 is accepted, so the shared loader registry path is now available.

C: nhlsel.c:l_selection_setpoint is registered as selection.set; Val-strt calls it for selection:set() and selection.set(selection.new()). The helper obtains its random or explicit coordinate with sp_lev.c:get_location_coord and current gc.coder->croom.
dependencies: Accepted C176 at 35162f9194bc8a959469d0c48716c29bf7af0bd7 implements nhlsel.c:l_selection_or/l_selection_sub and numeric selection storage in js/nhlsel.js and js/themerooms.js; Val-strt can use those existing operations.

C181 is accepted at 438d5d0cd3f837bbc821b6ff78ce82940470a5f8. Its GOALS.json completion marks makemon.c:m_initweap complete; the existing js/makemon_create.js implementation supplies the two fixed fire giants. No active C181 reservation remains.

nhlsel.c:l_selection_setpoint uses existing sp_lev.c:get_location_coord; js/room_coordinates.js:get_location_coord accepts ANY_LOC, the coder frame, current level state, and injected rn2. The special-level binding must pass current state, frame and coder room.

For the argc=2 setpoint form, C l_selection_setpoint calls nhlsel.c:l_selection_new to push a fresh selection; the JS port can return the existing selection_new() object directly because JavaScript has no Lua stack. The argc=0 form creates then discards that object before raising Selection setpoint error.

Read the complete upstream dat/Val-strt.lua (source SHA-256 33bc072378baf232f08fe3ca819ffdfe7e55d8c52fa0ac291a6d2512054b608e). It sets mazelevel, noteleport, hardfloor and icedpools before solidfill I; draws thirteen random setpoints and three additional selection points, then grows and unions those selections before painting P and L terrain and applying the 76-by-20 overlay map.

nhlsel.c:l_selection_setpoint lines 159–200 handles zero, one, two, and three-or-more Lua arguments, defaults point value to 1, calls get_location_coord with ANY_LOC and the active coder room/frame, mutates the chosen selection, and returns that selection. Its zero-argument form calls l_selection_new but then raises Selection setpoint error because sel is null. Implement the complete wrapper and preserve this error path.

For the recorded Val-strt sequence, the initial coder frame is xstart=1, ystart=0, xsize=79, ysize=21. Source setpoint calls consume thirteen plus three independent rn2(79), rn2(21) pairs; the second point has y=20, outside the later 20-row map. The subsequent random_wdir consumes rn2(4)=3, selecting west. These values diagnose the source sequence only; implementation must use the injected RNG and current frame.

C176 accepted the numeric selection storage, OR and subtraction operators at 35162f9194bc8a959469d0c48716c29bf7af0bd7. Current js/nhlsel.js contains l_selection_or and l_selection_sub; the remaining nhlsel.c wrapper l_selection_setpoint is absent.

C181 accepted at 438d5d0cd3f837bbc821b6ff78ce82940470a5f8 and records makemon.c:m_initweap complete. Val-strt.lua lines 98–99 place fire giants; upstream makemon.c:1443–1444 calls m_initweap before m_initinv when the species is armed. The accepted JS implementation is available for this task.

The full source order after selections includes the mapped terrain, branch arrival, down stair, fountain, locked doors, Norn and her two custom inventory objects, chest, eight Valkyrie warriors, non-diggable hall, six fire traps, ten fire ants, and two hostile fire giants. Existing lspo_* callers handle these descriptor forms; the loader must preserve source placement and RNG order.

No C replay or new recipe was run during this report refresh. The saved evaluation after accepted C181 repeats the same first mismatch and screen/RNG counts as the prior boundary; the current investigation now uses evaluation commit 438d5d0cd3f837bbc821b6ff78ce82940470a5f8.
